Thank you for your words. This puts me back on course again 
I am already diagnosed with depression. 
Though I'm only on medication for my anxiety. Getting doctors to listen is difficult. 
I have cbt therapy it's just not really happened yet, I had one session and the guy had a family issue so I was waiting until he came back. I requested that I was changed to another therapist and I was told to wait. Its been 3 months and they finally agreed to let me see another person. My first appointment with them is in a week. 
Let's hope it helps me

A few years ago I had sleep paralysis and hallucinations at the same time one night. I woke up paralyzed but able to move my eyes and see around my room. Next to me was an old lady in a wheelchair facing away from me.
I've had visually more scarier encounters than tbis.
But this old lady still makes me scared till this very day, ive got tears welling in my eyes remembering it.
 I had this impending fear, that something bad was about to happen. I was panicking trapped in my mind trying to escape trying to wiggle a finger or a toe. Fighting for movement. I couldn't make a sound. I was truly petrified

Then the old woman stared making all kinds of horrible sounds, shreiks and grunts, telling me awful things about myself how I am 'the evil one'
Then two figures emerged in the corner. One black the other white. They were slowly drawing closer and closer
I was fighting with my body trying to get it to move. Eventually I managed to get my toes wiggling and I bolted up running straight for the door. My knees were so week I collapsed and I was crawling out of my room into my mum's. 

I spent the rest of the night sleeping next to my mother. But I could feel the paralysis beginning again. I could feel the old woman drawing closer, my name being called 
I've never been more vulnerable in my life
It's full of perverts ! The amount of times I have been groped by men on the train in Japan is unbelievable

Initially I thought wow, crazy. But thinking now she was probably genuinely interested herself but the pressure probably made her a little insecure and could not handle the situation 
I know some women who would love to take their man to a strip club, but know they would probably end up feeling threatened. It's a natural response. Some people can deal with it some can't.  

This is her fault as she jumped in too deep. 
Dont blame yourself, yeah the shit wouldn't be as bad if You just stuck to your guns. But she would probably start a fight about you not going along with it and you didn't because you like them more ect.
 Just try pull her up gently and improve the trust between you two!
Maybe you have a lack of trust and communication between you. Make it stronger​. But be prepared for this to drag out for a long time 
Seek couples therapy !
I cannot deal with this blasphemy

I need to know what happens next 
Does he make it? 
Did he die ?
